newsitems.title: NARAKA：BLADEPOINT Update –October 22nd, 2026
newsitems.author: Yeeeeee
newsitems.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA：BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from October 21st, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC) to October 22nd, 2026 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p]Brand New Content[/p][p] [/p][p]New Chapter in Rift Traversal：Stormchant, Hongmen Banquet[/p][p]As the Qin dynasty fell, Xiang Yu crushed its armies at Julu, overawing the feudal lords. Liu Bang entered Guanzhong first, guarding Hangu Pass and encamping at Bashang. Upon hearing that "the Duke of Pei intends to rule Guanzhong," Xiang Yu flew into a rage and planned to attack the next day. Knowing he stood no chance, Liu Bang went to Hongmen to apologize. During the banquet, Fan Zeng had Xiang Zhuang perform a sword dance to assassinate Liu Bang. Liu Bang had no choice but to excuse himself and escape along a side path...[/p][p]I. In-game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Activity：\[Preparing the Hongmen Banquet]. Spawns in the Outerworld 2 minutes after the match begins.[/p][p]Gameplay Info:[/p][p]1) Return the scattered dining tables, seats, long tables, and other furnishings to their places to set up this important banquet.[/p][p]2) Once preparations are complete, you can claim a Crate reward and take a seat at the banquet to receive 1 additional reward.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Activity：\[Hongmen Banquet]. Spawns in the Innerworld 8 minutes after the match begins.[/p][p]Activity Overview：Dark undercurrents stir at the Hongmen Banquet. The hero must stay vigilant at all times and resolve Fan Zeng and Xiang Zhuang's treacherous plots against Liu Bang.[/p][p]1) Stage 1：Use a Blue Focus Strike to interrupt Fan Zeng's \[At the Drop of a Cup]. Successfully stopping him grants rewards and reduces the number of attacks Xiang Zhuang launches.[/p][p]2) Stage 2：Use Counter to block the repeated deadly attacks aimed at Liu Bang during \[Xiang Zhuang's Sword Dance].[/p][p]3) Receive 1-3 Crate rewards based on Liu Bang's remaining health at the end.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Activity：\[Escape from Hongmen]. Spawns in the Innerworld 11 minutes after the match begins.[/p][p]Activity：Liu Bang leaves the Hongmen Banquet on a pretext. The hero must escort him past the pursuing Chu Soldiers and back to the Han Camp. Reach the destination to receive a Crate reward.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Newly Added In-Match Mechanisms[/p][p]1. Rewind Device[/p][p]After activating the device, offer Relics worth the required value to reset Lootable Containers within range once the countdown ends. Eligible containers：Lootable Containers, \[Legendary Crates], and \[Epic Crates] (excluding Crates obtained from Caves, quests, or puzzles).[/p][p]2. Treasure Coffin[/p][p]Newly added the interactive Lootable Container \[Treasure Coffin] to the Stormchant map. Opening it requires the special key \[Coffin Crowbar], grants high-value Relics, and consumes \[Coffin Crowbar] durability. \[Coffin Crowbar] can be found during matches or obtained from the Trading Market.[/p][p]III. Xiling Seal Art Society Crossover[/p][p]1. New in-match gameplay added to the Stormchant map：Pick up a \[Seal Casket] in the Outerworld to unseal the map's August Banners and collect Duke of Pei Tokens. Collect any 3 to obtain a complete set of Stormchant Seals. You can then strike the zhu to play "Stormchant" for a chance to obtain the Xiling Seal Art Society crossover Relic \[Stormchant·Seal].[/p][p]2. Event Duration：Oct. 21st, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC) to Nov. 18th, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC). During the event, a progress bar is added at the bottom right of the Home screen：Crossover Collection·Stormchant·Seal. Search Lootable Containers in matches to fill the progress bar. When it's full, you're guaranteed to find a crossover collectible. After the event ends, you can still obtain these collectibles by searching containers.[/p][p]IV. New Camp Character[/p][p]1) Huang Jikao has left the camp. After completing the season quests \[A Letter from an Old Friend] and \[Visit the Sage], the camp will unlock a new sage, Fan Zeng, who will help players gain Epiphany into the deep mysteries hidden within the Relics.[/p][p]2) After understanding the Relic Mysteries, the corresponding exclusive ability will be unlocked for the player.[/p][p]3) After deciphering the core mysteries of each Relic, you will unlock the season-exclusive Combat Items.[/p][p]There are three season-exclusive Combat Items this season：\[Marvel·Heavy Armor], \[Marvel·Pursuit], and \[Marvel·Mandate].[/p][p]\[Marvel·Heavy Armor]：After use, the Overlord Armor protects you, granting immunity to Ranged attacks for 120 sec.[/p][p]\[Marvel·Pursuit]：After use, automatically lock onto the player with the highest Loadout Score in the match for 240 sec. Your damage dealt to that player increases by 15%.[/p][p]\[Marvel·Mandate]：Use it to obtain the quest series \[Trace of Treasures]. Complete all quests to receive a secret crate reward.[/p][p]Seasonal Combat Items cannot be traded at the Trading Market. At the end of the season, Fan Zeng will leave, and all related research progress and abilities will reset. Combat Items already obtained will be retained. Exclusive Combat Items from previous seasons can still be used this season, but can no longer be crafted or redeemed. Seasonal Combat Items being crafted when the season changes will be automatically canceled.[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Newly Added Collectibles[/p][p]Newly added 6 collectibles：\[Silver Overlord Armor], \[Map of Dugang], \[Imperial Crimson Pearl], \[Annals of Lü Buwei], \[Su Qin's Insignia], and \[Taigong's Six Secret Teachings]. Each collectible has its own Examine Emote![/p][p] [/p][p]VI. Escort Codex Update[/p][p]Outside matches, spend Void Coins to open the \[Hongmen Volume] and obtain various extraction equipment and items, with a chance to draw the limited-edition weapon skin \[Xu Furen Blade]![/p][p] [/p][p]VII. New Equipment and Rubrics[/p][p]New Celestia equipment：Polesword \[Sumeru], Staff \[Cloudsoar], and Kaleidoscope Parasol \[Calm the Storm].[/p][p]New Legendary and Extreme equipment：Polesword \[Polesword·Honing], Staff \[Staff·Wound], and Kaleidoscope Parasol \[Kaleidoscope Parasol·Ignition] \[Kaleidoscope Parasol·Drench].[/p][p]New Rubrics：\[Flame Reversal], \[Scorching Wind], \[Throatseeker], \[Shattered Starpearl], and \[Switch·Radiance].[/p][p]Limited-time Events[/p][p]1. A Taste of the Journey[/p][p]Taste ignorance, doubt, greed, anger, and pride; savor bitterness, sourness, sweetness, spice, and salt![/p][p]Event Duration：Oct. 22nd, 2026 Update - Nov. 4th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, complete Daily Quests and Weekly Quests to earn the limited-time item, Snack Charm. Weekly Quests refresh every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). Once the event ends, each Snack Charm can be dismantled for 50 Tae.
(2) Submit 1 Snack Charm to advance 20 miles. Each location you reach unlocks its corresponding story.
(3) Reaching each location unlocks its story and grants rewards; some of these rewards will open for claiming once the new hero Kael launches. Stay tuned!
(4) As Kael advances, various special events will trigger. Each type differs in effect, and all will be revealed one by one along the way.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Candlelit Tale[/p][p]Some stories begin only when the candle is lit.[/p][p]Event Duration：Oct. 22nd, 2026 Update - Nov. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, each week you can obtain Night Tale Fragments by opening stashes in the Survival modes, searching for supplies in Rift Traversal, playing Showdown, or playing Casual Mode. Weekly match output is capped at 400, and refreshes every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). Purchase any Outfit from the Candlelit Tale series to receive a large amount of additional Night Tale Fragments.
(2) Night Tale Fragments can be used to deduce story paths and unlock endings. Event rewards will be granted based on the number of endings unlocked.
(3) Additional event rewards will also be unlocked based on the number of truths deduced. Devourer Treasure and Candlelit Tale series Collection are waiting for you![/p][p] [/p][p]3. Swordlight and Shadow[/p][p]Event Duration：Oct. 22nd, 2026 Update - Nov. 4th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) Gain Nineglow Jade by completing quests during the event. Nineglow Jade can be redeemed for rare rewards.[/p][p](2) Event item redemption ends on Nov. 8th, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem in time.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Official Team Shopping[/p][p]Event Duration：Oct. 22nd, 2026 Update - Nov. 11th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, participating in the pre-order contributes to Server Cheer Points. The higher the total, the lower the final purchase price, up to the maximum discount.[/p][p](2) During the pre-order period, pay 240 Gold to reserve the \[Void-Eater Pack (Kael)] and claim the pre-order bonus：Serene Treasure Choice Gift*1.[/p][p](3) Pre-orders end when the item goes on sale. Players who placed a pre-order must pay the remaining balance at the discounted price determined by the final Server Cheer Point total to receive the item. Note：If the remaining balance is not paid before the event ends, the deposit will not be refunded.[/p][p](4) Players who miss the pre-order can purchase the item once it goes on sale at the discounted price determined by the final Server Cheer Point total, but will not receive the \[pre-order bonus].[/p][p](5) During the official team shopping period, the event interface will close once the player completes their purchase.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]5. Disturbance on the Isle[/p][p]Nuxin lifted wanchu from the sunken island and set it adrift upon the sea. A month later, the heavens suddenly cracked open.
Chaos from another world gazed into this realm, opening a colossal maw to drink in the boundless waters.[/p][p]In moments, jade halls and shell palaces wrenched free, while towers and grand halls rose with the tide.[/p][p]Event Duration：Oct. 29, 2026 04:00 (UTC) - Nov. 11, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) Players who sign in a total of 7 days during the event can obtain rewards such as a Legendary Avatar, Devourer Treasure, and Serene Treasure Choice Gift.[/p][p] [/p][p]Hero Adjustments[/p][p] [/p][p]Matari[/p][p]1. Adjusted the duration of all team members' Attack boost granted by the Ultimate \[Invisible Assassin] from 20 seconds to 15 seconds.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Underwater Combat[/p][p]1. Optimized basic Horizontal Strikes, Vertical Strikes, and certain charged moves underwater for heroes who use special weapons after activating their Ultimates, including Yoto Hime, Ye Xiu, Yueshan (Almighty General), and Inor Wan (Thunder Lord). Enabled upward and downward aiming for these attacks.[/p][p]2. Optimized the aiming mechanics of Tara Gan's Ultimate \[Fate Rewritten·Backtrack] when cast underwater, adding lock-on assistance.[/p][p]Weapon Adjustments[/p][p]I. Spear[/p][p]1. Optimized Vertical Strike Charged Attacks to address an issue where they sometimes couldn't clash properly.[/p][p] [/p][p]In-game Adjustments[/p][p]I. Feature Optimizations[/p][p]1. Casual Mode - Martial Artist Duel·Competition optimizations[/p][p](1) The opening cutscene can now be skipped once all players choose to skip it.[/p][p](2) Reduced the waiting time between rounds in Solo.[/p][p]2. Casual Mode - Neo-Mech Clash rotation & optimizations[/p][p](1) Newly added playable Hero：Yoto Hime[/p][p]Changes:
[/p][p]1) Extended the slash range of Yoto Hime's charged Vertical Strike move during her Ultimate and increased the damage of her Ultimate's finishing move \[Lacerate]. \[Combat Insight] can now be accumulated again after a short delay following its use.[/p][p]2) \[Ultimate·Advancement] enhancement：Extends the slash range of \[Lacerate] and increases the number of slashes.[/p][p](2) Adjusted the environment：Slightly reworked the arena, adding a more open central plaza and slightly increasing the density of surrounding buildings to focus combat on the central area and create a more balanced battlefield.[/p][p](3) Optimized spawn points：Made spawn locations more random and added more buildings for cover to reduce situations where one side is pinned down in its spawn area.[/p][p] [/p][p]Out-game Adjustments[/p][p]Casual Mode Adjustments[/p][p]1. To coincide with the launch of \[Neo-Mech Clash], \[Capture the Spirit Well] will be temporarily unavailable after this update. Please refer to future announcements for its return date.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Newly Added Resource Pack Management Function[/p][p]Players can choose which resource packs to download or delete according to their gameplay needs, either through the launcher or via the in-game resource management menu.[/p][p]1. In the launcher, players can select resource packs to download when installing the game for the first time. After installation, use the \[Resource Manager] button to download or delete resource packs.[/p][p]2. In-game, go to \[Settings] - \[Download Settings] to view resource packs by game mode and download or delete them.[/p][p]3. After deleting a map resource pack, you will no longer be able to select that map for Matchmaking. Deleted resource packs can be downloaded again through the menus above. The map will become selectable again once the download is complete.[/p][p] [/p][p]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/p][p]I. New Equipment

1) New Celestia Polesword：Sumeru[/p][p]Arcane：Earthshaker Slash[/p][p]Changed the three-stage charged Horizontal Strike and the Horizontal Strike following a pommel strike.[/p][p] [/p][p]2) New Immortal Treasure Staff：Cloudsoar[/p][p]Arcane：Havoc in Heaven[/p][p]The Vertical Strike following onslaught or Heaven Uproar becomes Stanchion·Rising Cloud.[/p][p] [/p][p]3) New Celestia Kaleidoscope Parasol：Calm the Storm[/p][p]Arcane：Kaleidoscope·Parasol·Deflation[/p][p]Parasol-form Kaleidoscope·Flux will apply \[Deflation]
(\[Deflation] and \[Burn] will produce the \[Deflagration] effect)[/p][p]4) New Legendary and Extreme Kaleidoscope Parasol：Kaleidoscope Parasol·Ignition

Extreme：Kaleidoscope·Shield·Burn

Shield-form Kaleidoscope·Flux will apply \[Burn][/p][p] [/p][p]5) New Legendary and Extreme Kaleidoscope Parasol：Kaleidoscope Parasol·Drench

Extreme：Kaleidoscope·Axe·Soaked

Axe-form Kaleidoscope·Flux will apply \[Soaked]
(\[Soaked] and \[Burn] will produce the \[Vaporize] effect)[/p][p] [/p][p]6) New Legendary and Extreme Polesword：Polesword·Honed

Extreme：Stone Form·Skybreaker[/p][p]Using Battle Stride or performing Stone Form grants a 5% Attack boost for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.[/p][p] [/p][p]7) New Legendary and Extreme Staff：Staff·Wound

Extreme：Relentless Lunge·Ban[/p][p] [/p][p]Increased Relentless Lunge's Damage by 88% and added Silence to its effects.[/p][p]8) New Rubrics:

Flame Reversal：Increased the duration of \[Burn], \[Deflation], and \[Soaked].[/p][p]Scorching Wind：Increased the Damage dealt by \[Burn] and \[Deflation].[/p][p]Throatseeker：Newly added a 2nd-stage attack for the parasol-form Kaleidoscope Parasol's charged Horizontal Strike. Enemies hit with the first move will be temporarily Silenced.[/p][p]Shattered Starpearl：Alters the Kaleidoscope Parasol's all-form Crouching Horizontal Strike and Sliding Horizontal Strike. After use in any form, it returns to parasol form.[/p][p]Switch·Radiance：Switch to a congeneric weapon after attacking or while charging to unleash a strike that suppresses the opponent's Common Attacks and Focus Strikes. A successful suppression grants Recovery and lets you immediately use a powerful move.[/p][p]II. New Amulets[/p][p]1. Newly added \[Taichu Soul Anchor·Blade].[/p][p]Increased damage dealt by special weapons during non-transforming heroes' Ultimates by 36%.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Newly added \[Taichu Soul Anchor·Everlight][/p][p]During transforming heroes' Ultimates, every 1350 damage dealt extends the Ultimate's duration by 3 seconds.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Newly added \[Spirit Seal·Maven Magnetist][/p][p]· While \[Metal Fusion] is active, Auric Sword seals can block enemy weapon attacks.[/p][p]· While \[Metal Fusion] is active, Auric Sword seals inflict Vulnerability on enemies they hit.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Newly added \[Spirit Seal·The Powderkeg][/p][p]· While \[Mech Mayhem：Co-pilot] is active, enhanced cannon hits restore additional Energy.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. Newly added \[Spirit Seal·The Floating Petal][/p][p]· While \[Untouched Leaf] is active, lock-on speed is increased.[/p][p]· While \[Untouched Leaf] is active, \[Resolved] restores additional Stamina and Divine Intent.[/p][p]III. In-Match Gameplay Optimizations

1. Stormchant Bulletin Board Update[/p][p]1) Updated all Stormchant Bulletin Board quests for the new season. New quests will no longer be posted midway through a match.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Old Sophora Adjustments and Optimizations[/p][p]1) Adjusted Old Sophora's Level-2 blessing trigger thresholds to 2 million /3.6 million /5 million for Tranquil Path/Perilous Path/Doomed Path, respectively.[/p][p]2) Added a multi-select button for offerings to Old Sophora.[/p][p]3) Moved the former Level-2 blessing effect, "Chance to find additional Relics when opening a new container," to Level 1 and adjusted its values accordingly.[/p][p]4) Newly added a Level-2 blessing effect. Once activated, all players who participated in the blessing can activate the \[Treasure Sophora] mechanism. All players who contributed offerings can interact with Treasure Sophora to draw rewards, with a chance to obtain high-value Relics.[/p][p]3. Other Optimizations[/p][p]1) During the \[Rescue·Find Liu Bang] quest, if the Terracotta General remains undefeated seven minutes before the match ends, Liu Bang will spawn automatically and can be interacted with directly.[/p][p]2) Optimized and adjusted buildings in the Preparing the Hongmen Banquet area on the Stormchant map, with corresponding adjustments to some Lootable Containers.[/p][p]3) Adjusted some spawn points in the Preparing the Hongmen Banquet area on the Stormchant map.[/p][p]4) Adjusted some \[Legendary Crate] spawn locations on the River Runs Red map.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. In-Match Reward Distribution Optimizations[/p][p]1. Added extra drops of high-value Season Collections for interrupting Fan Zeng's \[At the Drop of a Cup] in the new in-match activity \[Hongmen Banquet], and to \[White Emperor Crate·Legendary] obtained from \[Hongmen Banquet] and \[Escape from Hongmen].[/p][p]2. Slightly reduced the extra drop weights of \[White Emperor Crate·Legendary] obtained from solving Nightglow Pearl puzzles, defeating the Terracotta General, awakening Liu Bang, and defeating the Snake Guardian on the Stormchant map, reallocating them to other events. Following these adjustments, extra drops from \[White Emperor Crate·Legendary] obtained across the map's events will still increase slightly overall.[/p][p] [/p][p]Perilous Path Unlock Level Adjustment[/p][p]1. Reduced the level required to unlock Perilous Path to Reputation Level 1.[/p][p]VI. Forge & Reforge
1. Newly added help instructions and guide videos to the Forge and Reforge interfaces, explaining Forge, Attributes, Invalidation, Reforge, and the uses of Tokens.[/p][p] [/p][p]VII. Training Ground Optimizations：Newly Added Forge Function[/p][p]Showdown Adjustments[/p][p] [/p][p]I. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]1. Slightly extended the Counter windows for Vajra, Almighty General, and Thunder Lord.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Potential System Optimizations[/p][p]1. Changed \[Upgrade] to \[Upgrade to Max Level]. When enough Potential Points remain, the current Potential will automatically be upgraded to the maximum level. The single-level upgrade function remains available.[/p][p]2. After the season reset, all heroes' Potential Plans will reset to the default Potential Plan. Players whose plans have already been reset will not be affected during the current season.[/p][p][/p][p] I. NARAKA: BLADEPOINT PC FSR 4 Support Extended to RX 6000 Series — Full Coverage of RX 9000/7000/6000 Series[/p][p]1. FSR 4 is AMD's machine learning-based super-resolution technology that reconstructs lower-resolution images into high-quality visuals with clear details and smooth edges. Previously, players using AMD Radeon RX 9000 and RX 7000 series graphics cards could already enable FSR 4 in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT. Now, AMD has further extended support to RX 6000 series graphics cards, achieving full coverage across Radeon RX 9000, 7000, and 6000 series.[/p][p]After updating the game, players with RX 6000 series graphics cards can enable FSR 4 in the graphics settings. Before enabling it, please update your graphics driver to AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.10.1 or higher and enable AMD FSR Frame Generation; otherwise, this option will be unavailable. Please update your graphics driver and game in time to experience the clearer, more detailed battlefields of the Morus Isle.[/p][p]For specific support details, please refer to the official announcement: AMD FSR Upscaling 4.1 Boosts Frames and Image Quality - AMD Newsroom[/p][p][/p][p]Store Updates[/p][p]I. Distribution Details for the Longsword Version of \[The Legend of Qin·Shark Teeth][/p][p]Distribution Date：After the update on October 22, 2026[/p][p]Distribution Details:
1. Players who have purchased the Greatsword Skin \[The Legend of Qin·Shark Teeth] can claim the Longsword version of \[The Legend of Qin·Shark Teeth] for free via in-game mail after the update.
2. Players who purchase the Greatsword Skin \[The Legend of Qin·Shark Teeth] afterward will automatically receive the Longsword version of \[The Legend of Qin·Shark Teeth] with their purchase.
3. Due to the large number of items being distributed, mail delivery may be delayed. Thank you for your patience.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Packs[/p][p]1. Newly added Yoto Hime's exclusive Pack \[Enthralling Night Pack (Yoto Hime)], containing Yoto Hime's Legendary Ultimate Accessory \[Candlelit Tale·Umbra Bat] (unlocks a new appearance for Yoto Hime's Ultimate \[Demon Blade], not including the appearance of the whirling blade flung out as a part of her ultimate "Demon Blade") and Legendary Skill Accessory \[Candlelit Tale·Crimson Heart] (unlocks a new appearance for Yoto Hime's skill \[Flying Edge], as well as that of the whirling blade flung out as a part of her ultimate 'Demon Blade'). Standard price：5,000 Gold; Now：3,000 Gold. Individual items are also discounted, with greater savings when purchasing the Pack. (This Pack and its individual items will be available for a limited time from October 22 to November 5.)[/p][p]2. Newly added Yoto Hime's exclusive Pack \[Violet Wings Pack (Yoto Hime)], containing Yoto Hime's Legendary Outfit \[Candlelit Tale·Violet Wings] and the Legendary Greatsword Skin \[Candlelit Tale·Soulsever]. Standard price：4,200 Gold; Now：2,400 Gold. Individual items are also discounted, with greater savings when purchasing the Pack. (This Pack and its individual items will be available for a limited time from October 22 to November 5.)[/p][p]3. Newly added Kurumi's exclusive Pack \[Porcelain Dream Pack (Kurumi)], containing Kurumi's Legendary Outfit \[Candlelit Tale·Porcelain Dream] and Legendary Hairstyle \[Candlelit Tale·Sealed Dream]. newsitems.author: Yeeeeee
newsitems.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA： BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Oct. 8th, 2026 23：00 (UTC) to Oct. 9th, 2026 04：00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows：[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][h2][b]I. The Legend of Qin Crossover Game Mode[/b][/h2][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th Update - Nov. 4th 20：00 (UTC)
1. Crescent Moon Valley Battle
"The hoofbeats never cease in Crescent Moon Valley, and the Qin soldiers are already closing in. The only choice now is to draw your sword and fight your way out in a bloody battle..."
1) In the Survival Modes (excluding Immortal War) and Rift Traversal mode, \[Moonfall Gate] will appear some time after the match begins. Once activated, players can interact to teleport to \[Crescent Moon Valley]. \[Moonfall Gate] supports only 2 teams of players and will close after some time.
2) Entering \[Crescent Moon Valley] via \[Moonfall Gate] lets you challenge a special in-match stage： protect Tianming, fight a bloody battle against the Qin soldiers, and rout all enemies. The shorter the time taken, the richer the rewards.
3) When a player's HP is nearly depleted, it will instantly be restored to full, but each trigger lowers Attack; this effect lasts for a period of time.

2. Whimsical Melody Chest
During the crossover, a "Whimsical Melody Chest" will appear in Survival Modes (excluding Immortal War) and Rift Traversal mode. By attacking and interacting, players can decipher the chest's mechanism to earn rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Showdown Event Stages \[Suffer No Demon] Return![/p][p] [/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 00：00 (UTC) - Nov. 3rd, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. During the event, access the event stage from the Showdown map. Complete challenges to earn limited Hero Badges, Exhilarating Elixirs, Skyfall Cataclysm Souljade Choice Gift, and more.[/p][p]2. Sense level difference does not apply in event stages. The event has two chapters：[/p][p]· Picking up "Manticore Soul·Stone" in the "Lion's Roar" stage makes the Airborne Vertical Strike trigger falling rocks.[/p][p]· Picking up "Manticore Soul·Thunder" in the "Thunder Trial" stage infuses Defuse (Counterattack) and Aegis-break Martial Skill with Divine Thunder Waves.[/p][p]3. Event stages have their own Souljade drops, suitable for farming specific Souljades. Both chapters share the same drops, including： \[Pyreheart], \[Venom Tempering], \[Primal Starfall], \[Ice Ring Break], \[Thunder Rove], \[Star-Shattering Force], \[Polesword·Blistering Edge][/p][p](4) Each chapter has two difficulty stages that consume different amounts of Fatigue, but all stages share the same Souljade drop rates. Choose difficulty based on your capabilities.[/p][p]5. Chapter 1 stages are available immediately upon the event starting, while Chapter 2 stages unlock on Oct 20th, 2026 20：00 (UTC), at which point Chapter 1 stages will be closed.[/p][p]6. Event stages offer trial access to Inor Wan, Kurumi, Justina Gu each with preset Souljade builds.[/p][h2][b]III. Limited-time Events： [/b][/h2][p]1. All Under Heaven[/p][p]Among the hundred schools, only the valiant reigns supreme.[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Oct. 28th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules：[/p][p]1. During the event, open stashes in the Survival modes, search for supplies in Rift Traversal, or play Showdown or Casual Mode each week to obtain Fragments of the Legend;
Up to 400 Fragments of the Legend can be obtained each week. The first refresh time is Oct 14th, 2026 at 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]2. Submit the required number of Fragments of the Legend to increase Alliance and claim progress reward;[/p][p]3. Accumulate Alliance to unlock sealed chapters of The Legend of Qin.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Dawnless Night[/p][p]Night unfurls its thousand shadows; one sword splits the dark to dawn.[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Oct. 20th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. Complete quests during the event to claim rewards.[/p][p]2. There are 5 quest sets, unlocking one after another daily upon the event start.[/p][p]3. Quests must be completed in order, and completing all 5 sets will grant the full event rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Dew Bazaar[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Oct. 15th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules：[/p][p]1. The Dew Bazaar will hold a limited-time sale on \[Hadi·Skyhunter Morning Dew Gift]. Use to unlock Hadi's Outfit \[Urban Hunt·Skyhunter], Hairstyle \[Urban Hunt·Wild], and Avatar \[Urban Hunt·Hadi].[/p][p]2. The first round of sales will start at 12：00 (UTC) on Oct. 9th, 2026. Points Reward： Unlocking direct-purchase Collection items included in the item pool will accumulate progress at a 1：1 ratio based on the standard price.[/p][p] [/p][p]​6. newsitems.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update –September 16th, 2026
newsitems.author: Yeeeeee
newsitems.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 16th, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 17th, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Casual Mode: Martial Artist Duel·Competition[/p][p]· In Martial Artist Duel·Competition, every Hero's initial Rage will start at 100%.
· The competition will be played in a best-of-five format. The first player to win three battles is the winner.
· Players need to select the Heroes and weapons they will use in the preparation phase before the match. The same heroes and weapons can't be selected.
· The winner of each battle must be decided within a certain period of time. If both players are still standing at the end of the battle, then: 
   (1) The player who deals more damage wins;
   (2) If the above values are the same, the player with the higher remaining Health and Armor wins;
   (3) If they are still the same, the player who deals damage to the opponent first wins. 
· Each player's Health, Armor, and Skill CDs will be reset after each battle.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Limited-time Event:[/p][p]1. Dueling! 0924[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) Participate in the events to earn Chaser's Cards. The Chaser's Cards you earn count toward both your personal progress and server-wide progress.[/p][p](2) Collect 1,400 Chaser's Cards to claim all personal progress rewards.[/p][p](3) After the tournament ends, a limited-time sign-in event will begin, offering a large number of Chaser's Cards and exclusive rewards. Stay tuned![/p][p] [/p][p]2. Dueling Masters![/p][p]Dueling! 0924—enter the fray and feel the thrill of the arena![/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, complete 1 match of Martial Artist Duel·Competition or 2 matches in any mode daily to claim Duel Points and unlock generous rewards.[/p][p](2) Special Martial Artist Duel·Competition matches (best of three) will be available for a limited time every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Duel Points will be awarded based on wins per round—the more wins, the richer the points.[/p][p](3) All players will compete on the leaderboard based on match results. After the event ends, players on the overall leaderboards will receive limited title rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Race to Gold[/p][p]The Herald's Trial vie to stand Ahead of the Rest, as Eternal Glory shines across the land.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, complete Daily and Challenge Quests to obtain Chosen One Gold Medal.[/p][p](2) Chosen One Gold Medal can be used in the \[Glory Prize Pool] to redeem Viper Ning's exclusive Legendary Hairstyle, the Legendary Background, Polar Light Treasure Choice Gift and other rewards.[/p][p]The claim period for this event ends at 20:00 on October 8, 2026 (UTC). Please keep track of your redemption progress to avoid expiry.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Treasure Chase[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) Complete Daily and Challenge Quests to obtain the item Chaser's Torches. Accumulated Chaser's Torches grant level EXP and unlock rewards at different levels.[/p][p](2) Purchase the Advanced Treasure Chase Pass from the in-game event page or externally to unlock the Advanced Treasure Chase and earn Advanced-exclusive rewards, including Legendary Outfits and Gold.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. Cheer Supply Station[/p][p]Energy online—the arena ignites![/p][p]Laurels Banner Random Gift offers a chance to get one of three new Legendary Banners![/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules: During the event, you can collect event-related Collections to obtain event-exclusive rewards, with three Legendary Banners waiting for you.[/p][p]Laurels Banner Random Gift: Open to randomly get one of the following items: Banner·Martial Duel, Banner·Eternal Glory, Banner·Undefeated, Legendary Melee Choice Gift, Legendary Ranged Choice Gift, Legendary Outfit Choice Gift, Regular Treasure, various Items, Tae, Spectral Silk.[/p][p] [/p][p]6. Eternal Glory[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, three types of boosts refresh daily. No selection is required; they will automatically trigger and consume uses when you participate in the specified modes.[/p][p](2) Boosts can be triggered 3 times per day, and all three boosts share the total uses.[/p][p](3) Complete the Survival modes, Showdown (excluding Yama's Abyss), Rift Traversal, and Casual Mode to earn a corresponding amount of Chaser's Cards at match settlement based on your in-match actions, including but not limited to Damage dealt, Counters, healing, and more. The weekly cap for Chaser's Cards earned from matches is 200. Teaming up with Justice Chamber members or Heroes who returned within the last 7 days increases the efficiency of earning Chaser's Cards in battle.[/p][p] [/p][p]7. Mooncake Mania[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 24th, 2026 04:00 (UTC) - Oct. 18th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, earn Moonfruit Dust each week by opening Stashes in the Survival modes, searching supplies in Rift Traversal, and playing Showdown or Casual Mode. Up to 400 can be earned from matches per week, resetting every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC).[/p][p](2) You may consume 1 Moonfruit Dust to place 1 selected filling on the wooden board. When two of the same fillings collide, they merge into a higher-tier filling and grant Moon Honey. The red frame marks the wooden board area. When the board is filled with fillings, the current round ends, and you can start a new round.[/p][p](3) As your Moon Honey accumulates, you will unlock corresponding event rewards.[/p][p](4) You may enlist heroes to assist with filling merges. Each successful merge builds Rage for the selected Hero. Once Rage reaches 60, the Hero's assist Ultimate can be unleashed. Each of the four heroes has a unique Ultimate, and you can switch heroes at any time.[/p][p](5) Infinite Moon-Pounding is available for players who wish to experience the mode. In Infinite Moon-Pounding, Moonfruit Dust is not consumed, but Moon Honey cannot be obtained.[/p][p] [/p][p]8. After this update, new weekly quests will be available in the Martial Cutie event, and the original weekly quests will end.[/p][p]Quest Duration: Sep 17th 20:00 - Oct. 7th, 20:00 (UTC). Quests will reset at 20:00 (UTC) on Wednesday.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p] [/p][p]I. Anassa Nangong[/p][p]1. Slightly reduced the stagger duration after being hit by non-Charge \[Needle Strike].[/p][p]2. Optimized the handling of consecutive Dodges on thread in matches.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Water Combat[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]1. While diving, using Ascend to reach the water surface no longer launches you into the air.[/p][p]2. While diving, weapon attack moves no longer consume Momentum.[/p][p]3. While diving, the Skill \[Tidesurge] is restored to its original maximum level, and its performance no longer scales with Momentum level.[/p][p]4. While diving, the displacement of attack moves is no longer affected by Momentum level; Momentum level only affects move damage.[/p][p]5. Optimized melee tracking direction for attack moves while diving.[/p][p]6. Adjusted weapon attack moves while diving. Horizontal and Vertical Strikes now share the same move; the 1st and 2nd stages are non-Focus moves, and the 3rd stage is a Focus strike move.[/p][p]7. Fixed a bug where attacks could not be used after performing a Grappling Strike into the air while diving.[/p][p] [/p][p]In-game Adjustments[/p][p]I. Spawn Selection Optimization for The Herald's Trial[/p][p]Players will now automatically follow the first team member to select a spawn location by default, unless the selected tile cannot accommodate the entire team.[/p][p]II. Effect Priority Adjustment of \[Sunwing Bloom Essence][/p][p]The Survivability effect of \[Sunwing's Might] will now trigger prior to other Survivability effects.[/p][p]III. Immortal War Adjustments[/p][p]1. Reward adjustments for the 2nd round of Realm of Yang in Solo mode:[/p][p](1) Added the reward Vermilion Bird Scroll·Survivability, and removed White Tiger's Prowess and Mystic Might.[/p][p]Vermilion Bird Scroll·Survivability: Instantly restores a certain amount of Health, Armor, and Rage for allies. All surviving allies gain Vermilion Bird's Blessing, which grants a Survivability effect when entering the near-death state during its duration, as well as Damage Reduction and Attack; if the Survivability effect is not triggered during the duration, an attack buff will also be granted for a period of time.[/p][p](2) Added item Armor-Tempering Crystal, and removed item Yang Crystal Powder·Advanced.[/p][p]Armor-Tempering Crystal: Upgrade Armor to Legendary. Can be carried in the bag.[/p][p]2. Hid the elimination information in the Realm of Yang.[/p][p]3. The refresh time of Yang Spirit Well and Sacred Beast Spirit Well has been adjusted from 1050 sec to 1110 sec.[/p][p]4. The duration of the 2nd round's Gate of Yang has been adjusted from 45 sec to 30 sec; the Yang Depletion duration for this round only has been adjusted from 270 sec to 240 sec, and the extendable Yang Depletion time has been adjusted from 60 sec to 30 sec.[/p][p]IV. Increased the number of \[Realm of Spirit] by 1.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Out-game Adjustments[/b][/h1][p] [/p][p]I. Casual Mode Adjustments[/p][p]To prepare for the launch of \[Martial Artist Duel·Competition], \[Bloodsport] will be temporarily offline after this update.[/p][p]II. Avatars Now Support Collection Points[/p][p]After the update, Avatars will be integrated into the Collection system. Both existing and newly obtained Avatars will contribute to Collection Points.[/p][p]III. Photo Booth Update:[/p][p](1) Added 2 free scene components.[/p][p](2) Added 1 official multiplayer Photo Booth template.[/p][p] [/p][p]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/p][p]I. Asian Games Crossover Collectibles Available[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep 16th, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC) to Oct 8th, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC). During the event, a new progress bar will be added to the bottom right of the Home interface: Crossover·Asian Games·NARAKA Emblem. Search Lootable Containers in matches to accumulate progress on the bar. Once full, you are guaranteed to find a crossover collectible. After the event ends, you can still obtain collectibles from this series by searching Lootable Containers.[/p][p]Showdown Adjustments[/p][p]I. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]1. Optimized the hit VFX performance of Ice Elemental Healing Circles and Thunder Elemental Healing Circles in Kurumi's \[Purified Circle: Showdown].[/p][p]2. Potential \[Savagery] values adjusted from 6.5%/13%/19.5%/26%/32.5% to 8%/16%/24%/32%/40%.[/p][p]II. Specialized Practice[/p][p]1. Added \[Aegis-break Clash Tips] practice to Temulch and Inor Wan practice.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Join Sect Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]1. In the new Journey Begins, Quick Matchmaking·Trios mode has been added, while other participation conditions remain unchanged.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Feature Optimizations[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Client[/p][p]1. Optimized message handling for high polling rate mice.[/p][p]2. Optimized multi-threading for resource processing.[/p][p]3. Optimized engine rendering.[/p][p]II. Out-of-Game Inventory Optimizations[/p][p]1. Some items that already have notifications in other functions will no longer display red dots after entering the Inventory.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Store Updates[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. New Pack[/p][p]1. Added Feria Shen exclusive Pack \[Best Backup], which contains the Feria Shen Legendary Outfit \[Competitive Spirit·Best Backup], Feria Shen Legendary Hairstyle \[Competitive Spirit·Rhythm Flow], and Feria Shen Legendary Accessory \[Competitive Spirit·Sunhat]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,000 Gold. Individual cosmetics have discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]2. Added Kurumi exclusive Pack \[Edge Unbound], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Asian Games·Edge Unbound] and the Legendary Hairstyle \[Asian Games·Swift Shadow]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]3. Added Yueshan exclusive Pack \[Fearless Dawn], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Asian Games·Fearless Dawn] and the Legendary Hairstyle \[Asian Games·Dawnward]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]4. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,040 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Discounts[/p][p]1. Newly added Fan Legendary Skin \[Asian Games·Gilded Plume]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.[/p][p]2. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement \[Final Round]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.[/p][p]3. Newly added Legendary Rescue Effect \[Radio Calisthenics]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 320 Gold.[/p][p]4. Anassa Nangong Legendary Background \[Eternal Night·Crimson Reverie]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold. (This item will be removed on Oct 8.)[/p][p]5. Anassa Nangong Legendary Base \[Eternal Night·Abyssal Blossom]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold. (This item will be removed on Oct 8.)[/p][p] [/p][p]III. New Items in Item Store[/p][p]1. Newly added item \[Dye Lucky Jar]. Collect a certain amount to randomly unlock 1 Iridescent Paint variant for specified Collections (unlock probabilities can be viewed after selecting the paint in the Collection interface). Price: 20 Gold.[/p][p](1) Currently, \[Dye Lucky Jar] can be used to randomly unlock Iridescent Paint variants for Kurumi Outfit \[Asian Games·Edge Unbound] and Yueshan Outfit \[Asian Games·Fearless Dawn], with an equal drop rate for each variant.[/p][p](2) Unlocking a random paint variant for \[Asian Games·Edge Unbound] will also unlock the corresponding paint variant for \[Asian Games·Wind Unbound], though the base \[Asian Games·Wind Unbound] must be owned before equipping.[/p][p]2. newsitems.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update –September 3rd, 2026
newsitems.author: Yeeeeee
newsitems.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 2nd, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 3rd, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]I. Showdown Season 6.0: Sandforge[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]1. New Hero Inor Wan[/p][p]Forged in storm to cleave the wind.[/p][p]Inor Wan has joined Showdown! He arrives with an all-new skill and ultimate, unlike those in the Survival modes![/p][p] [/p][p]2. New Boss and New Chapter[/p][p]Forged from the crimson sand, veiled in serpent shadows. Herald Elder Vasshani's thousand‑year obsession is yours to awaken.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Brand New Souljades and Potentials[/p][p]The Qi Mastery Art can either enhance Elemental Burst effects or call down Meteor Rain from beyond the skies to devastate enemies. This update adds seven Souljades: \[Pyreheart], \[Venom Tempering], \[Primal Starfall], \[Ice Ring Break], \[Thunder Rove], \[Star-Shattering Force] and \[Polesword·Blistering Edge], and adjusts Potential effects to bring richer match options for every Hero.[/p][p]\[Pyreheart]: Elemental Crit Rate +30%, Move Damage -5%[/p][p]\[Venom Tempering]: Number of \[Toxified] stacks required to trigger an area strike -2. Elemental Accumulation Rate +60%.[/p][p]\[Primal Starfall]: Elemental Crits additionally summon a \[Meteor Strike], leaving a \[Meteor] at the impact point. When a \[Meteor] is hit by an Elemental Strike, it triggers \[Starburst]. Each \[Meteor] can only trigger this once.[/p][p]\[Ice Ring Break]: When a monster's Frostbite meter is full, triggers an extra Ice Ring Strike. Elemental Accumulation Rate +30%.[/p][p]Souljade \[Polesword·Blistering Edge]: \[Polesword]'s enhanced charged moves carry extra Elemental Accumulation.[/p][p]\[Thunder Rove]: Divine Thunder can be Countered, but its damage -50%. Countered Divine Thunder is reflected in a straight line, dealing a Round-Trip Strike. Elemental Accumulation Rate +60%.[/p][p]\[Star-Shattering Force]: After triggering \[Starburst], your Attack +20% for 15 sec.[/p][p]New Rare Attribute \[Sortilege]: Increases the chance to roll the Critical Hit determination twice and take the better result[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]4. Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss Reset[/p][p]Season Challenge progress and rewards of Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss have been reset. Saves of Nirriti's Ruins have been cleared.[/p][p]Take on Yama's Abyss and Nirriti's Ruins this season for Showdown Seal, limited-edition avatars, and much more![/p][p] [/p][p]5. Souljade Recast Updates[/p][p](1) Added "Spirit Essence" progress to the Recast[/p][p]· Each attribute or value recast grants 1 Spirit Essence. At 120 Spirit Essence, claim 1 Flux Shard in the Recast interface.[/p][p]· The progress bar in both attribute and value recast interfaces shows current Spirit Essence and the required amount for the guarantee.[/p][p]· Spirit Essence can exceed 120, and all accumulated rewards can be claimed at once.[/p][p]· After the update, existing rare attribute guarantee counts will convert to Spirit Essence at a 1:1 ratio.[/p][p] [/p][p](2) Souljade Essence Recast[/p][p]· A new tab has been added to the value recast interface, allowing switching between "Normal Recast" and "Souljade Essence Recast."[/p][p]· "Souljade Essence Recast" consumes 1 "Jade Essence Crystal" to greatly increase a Souljade's attribute values, roughly equivalent to 40 Normal Recasts (excess beyond the cap refunds materials proportionally). If used on a rare attribute, its value is directly raised to the cap.[/p][p]· "Jade Essence Crystal" can be obtained by completing any Showdown stage with Fatigue, or by completing Showdown weekly quests.[/p][p]· Each use of \[Jade Essence Crystal] for attribute Recast grants Spirit Essence equal to the corresponding increase.[/p][p] [/p][p](3) Rare Attribute and Attribute Value Adjustments[/p][p]· Attribute Recast no longer produces rare attributes[/p][p]· Souljades dropped from Showdown stages, and attributes obtained via Imbue with "Shrouded Jade," will now have values randomized within 50%–60% of the cap. Values near the cap will no longer appear.[/p][p]//Dev Note: The goal of this Recast rework is to improve the progression experience:
1. With Spirit Essence, you no longer need to think about recast order, it lowers both the learning curve and cost.
2. The new \[Jade Essence Crystal] cuts down on Souljade hoarding, making inventory management easier. It also eliminates the need to check every drop's stats after each match.[/p][p] [/p][p]6. Season Journey Quest Rewards Upgraded[/p][p]Season Journey Quests have been updated. After completing the beginner's Journey Quests, participate in Showdown to automatically unlock the Journey Quest of the current season.[/p][p]Within the limited event period after the season begins, complete any Showdown stage daily to claim daily rewards. Complete 7 days of quests to receive generous Journey rewards including a "Souljade Selection Gift" and the valuable "Legend Jade."[/p][p] [/p][p]7. Weekly Quest Optimization and Reward Upgrades[/p][p](1) It is no longer required to complete all weekly quests. Each completed quest grants Activeness; reaching certain Activeness thresholds unlocks all rewards.[/p][p](2) Normal Doom stages and their related weekly quests have been removed, with their rewards integrated into the current reward pool.[/p][p](3) Without any reduction in previous reward value (some Souljade gift packs have been consolidated into Souljade Fragments), weekly quests contribute to Legend Jade progress. A Legend Jade can be claimed after four full weeks of progress.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Hero: Anassa Nangong[/p][p]Threads bind the souls, needles claim the hearts.[/p][p]The world admires her needlework, and never once wonders at the blade.[/p][p]Under the Grain God's words, Vice Hierophant Anassa Nangong severs Icuria thread by thread, inch by inch.[/p][p]When the golden thread runs its course, it will not end at a hem, but in a royal robe of her own.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Showdown Paramount Season Settlement[/p][p]Paramount Season will end on Sep. 3rd, 2026 at 00:00 (UTC)[/p][p](1) Season Rewards:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p]Rank Requirement[/p][/td][td][p]Rewards[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Bronze[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Bronze][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Silver[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Silver][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Gold[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Gold][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Platinum[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Platinum][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Solar[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Solar], \[Serene Treasure Choice Gift]*2, \[Showdown Seal]*5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Empyrean[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Empyrean], \[Serene Treasure Choice Gift]*3, \[Showdown Seal]*10, Hero Badge \[Paramount·Showdown Empyrean][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Astral[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Astral], \[Serene Treasure Choice Gift]*5, \[Showdown Seal]*15, Hero Badge \[Paramount·Showdown Astral][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Showdown Paragon[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Paramount·Showdown Paragon], \[Serene Treasure Choice Gift]*10, \[Showdown Seal]*20, Hero Badge \[Paramount·Showdown Paragon][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p](2) Showdown Leaderboard Rewards[/p][p]Players will be rewarded with an Avatar that corresponds to the highest rank that they held on the Yama's Abyss leaderboards at any point during this Showdown Paramount Season (recorded either at weekly settlement or at season settlement). Additionally, the top 3 players on any Yama's Abyss Hero leaderboard will receive an exclusive Hero Badge.[/p][p]  [/p][p]IV. Limited-time Event:[/p][p] [/p][p]1. NARAKUP·Football Royale[/p][p] [/p][p]NARAKA Cup is about to kick off. Goalkeeper Lannie has been called in by the coach for training camp...[/p][p] [/p][p]Event Duration: After the Sep. 3rd, 2026 Update - Sep 16th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p] [/p][p]1. During the event, complete matches in the designated mode each week, and join "Air Dunk" or "Gold Rush" in Fairyland Penglai daily to earn Energy Bars.[/p][p]2. Tap to enter the \[Run Schedule] page, set Lannie's daily training schedule, spend Energy Bars to run it, raise her Overall Rating, and claim Score Rewards:[/p][p](1) Overall Rating is the sum of 5 ratings: Saving, Kickoff, Reflexes, Awareness, Catching.[/p][p](2) Tap an empty slot, pick 1–5 items from Training or Rest, then tap "Run Schedule" to spend the required Energy Bars. Once finished, you gain the corresponding training or rest effects.[/p][p](3) Training programs will increase Fatigue; Training effectiveness becomes worse for every 25 Fatigue gained.[/p][p](4) Spend Energy Bars to rest, reducing Lannie's Fatigue.[/p][p](5) After the schedule ends, the attribute with no rating growth that day will lose 10 points.[/p][p](6) Tap to view \[Training Quests] and meet their requirements for extra rewards![/p][p] [/p][p]Schedule rest wisely to stay in top form![/p][p] [/p][p]2. Gleam Phantom[/p][p] [/p][p]Crimson sand gleams through the rising formation. Strikes down evil and banishes the skulking spirits.[/p][p] [/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 3rd, 2026 Update - Sep. 16th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. Gain Mud Serpent Puppets, which can be exchanged for rare rewards.[/p][p]2. Finish all daily quests to unlock bonus special rewards.[/p][p]3. There are 5 sets of challenge quests, each unlocking sequentially at different times. Completing them will earn you generous rewards.[/p][p]4. Redemption for the event ends on September 20, 2026, at 20:00 (UTC). Make sure to redeem your rewards before the deadline.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #9[/p][p]With swords in hand, free and bold while exploring the world, unrestricted and unhampered. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #9 are available for a limited time![/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 3rd, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC) - Oct. 8th, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC).[/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Cloud Medal - SEP. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:[/p][p]1st place: 300 Medals[/p][p]2nd place: 200 Medals[/p][p]3rd-4th place: 100 Medals[/p][p]5th-8th place: 50 Medals[/p][p]Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.[/p][p]Time[/p][p]Server       Mon to Fri   Sat   Sun (UTC)[/p][p]NA 03:00 23:00 03:00[/p][p]AS 11:00 07:00 11:00[/p][p]SEA 11:00 07:00 11:00[/p][p]EU 19:00 15:00 19:00[/p][p] [/p][p]Start Time of the First Tournament (UTC):[/p][p]NA: Sep 4, 2026 03:00[/p][p]AS: Sep 4, 2026 11:00[/p][p]SEA: Sep 4, 2026 11:00[/p][p]EU: Sep 4, 2026 19:00[/p][p] [/p][p]4. PlayStation Challenge:[/p][p]Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #30 is now open![/p][p]Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.[/p][p]How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 3rd, 2026 00:00 (UTC) - Oct. 8th, 2026 23:59 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Fairyland Penglai Refresh[/p][p]1. The Seraphic Quartet area of Fairyland Penglai has added School Life event related gameplay.[/p][p]\[Air Dunk] A ball launcher has been added to the Seraphic Quartet in Fairyland Penglai. Players who catch the basketball in mid‑air will automatically perform a dunk action.[/p][p]\[Gold Rush]: Transform into a NARAKA ball, collect coins to earn points and energy. When the energy bar is full, you can enter "invincible" mode. The player fails if they voluntarily leave the gameplay area or enter the basketball court.[/p][p] [/p][p]VI. Martial Cutie[/p][p]After the update, new weekly quests will be available in the Martial Cutie event.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep 3rd Update - Sep 17th Update.
Quests will reset at 20:00 (UTC) on Wednesday.[/p][p]During the event, completing the quests to win Paw Tally and Anassa Nangong Exclusive Cosmetics[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p] [/p][p]I. Ye Xiu
1. Slightly increased the startup frames of the spear Charge thrust move in the Ultimate, and reduced its hit detection range.[/p][p]2. While in Ultimate, Charged Moves of the spear and scythe can be Countered, but no Counterstrike follows a successful Counter.[/p][p]3. Slightly increased Ye Xiu's running speed while charging in Ultimate Status, and slightly decreased his initial speed.[/p][p]4. While in Ultimate, the Focus of follow-up moves following a Charged Move hit is changed from Skill Golden Focus to Weapon Golden Focus. Melee follow-up moves can also Clash with the enemy's Weapon Golden Focus moves.[/p][p]II. Akos Hu
1. \[Roar: Blast] cannot penetrate walls to hit enemies, and its cooldown in Solo has been adjusted from 25 sec to 27 sec, its charged attacks' damage multiplier has been adjusted from 1.5 to 1.2.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Inor Wan
1. Adjusted the action priority of \[Bolt Dash]'s enhanced Dodge: when both the talent \[Spirit·Free] and the skill \[Bolt Dash] are active, a successful Counter will prioritize the post-Counter Dodge.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Wanchu Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Water Combat[/p][p]1. Added a mobile Charged Move for weapons: while on water or diving, hold Horizontal Strike to enter mobile charge.[/p][p]2. Increased the startup frames of the diving Vertical Strike.[/p][p]3. Reduced the recovery frames of the underwater Horizontal Strike, as well as the hit stun duration on hit.[/p][p]4. Optimized the timing for entering Water Walk during various actions while on water.[/p][p]5. Advanced the interruptible window of various actions while on water.[/p][p]Map[/p][p]1. Added \[Soaring Arm] mechanism deployment.[/p][p]2. Combat Items \[Ancient Oracle·Primal Echo], \[Ancient Oracle·Ethereal Descent], and \[Sea of Calamity] are now reusable with a 120 sec cooldown and 360 sec duration.
- \[Ancient Oracle·Primal Echo] Recovery adjusted from 250 to 200; Soaked Attack Reduction adjusted from 33% to 15%.
- \[Ancient Oracle·Ethereal Descent] hit damage adjusted from 4.5 to 2.25.
- \[Sea of Calamity] damage per sec adjusted from 80 to 50.[/p][p]3. Adjusted the positions of some Scout Bells in \[Wanchu] to make them easier to spot.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]The Evolution Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. The Evolution now features random selection between the Wanchu and Perdoria maps[/p][p]1. General Technique
\[Phoenix Blast·Skyfall] Enhances Phoenix Blast and extends the attack range of its sword energy 
\[Overlord·Reprisal] Enhances Overlord. After charging Stone Form to Stage 3, directly unleash a Counterstrike Combo
\[Relentless] During their Ultimates, Tianhai, Yueshan, Feria Shen, and Inor Wan extend Ultimate duration by 3 sec for every 600 Damage dealt
\[Hidden Edge] Land 3 non-charged hits to become Invisible for 4 sec
\[Fundamentals] A successful Counter or Dodge grants 4% Attack until you are knocked airborne[/p][p]\[Seafood Pack] Gain a Rare Soul-Devouring Armor, an Epic Thick Hide Armor, and a Legendary Habitat Armor.[/p][p]\[Urchin Buffet] Gain 2 Iron Urchins. Cooldown: 40 sec
\[Goddess's Grace] Gain either Ancient Oracle·Primal Echo or Ancient Oracle·Ethereal Descent, with a small chance to gain both. Cooldown: 90 sec
\[One Shot to Glory] Gain Combat Item: Ballista (summons a Ballista). Cooldown: 120 sec
\[Countershift] Tianhai, Yueshan, and Inor Wan can Counter while their Ultimates are active
\[Last Stand] When Health drops below 10%, gain 60% Rage and launch nearby enemies airborne. Can trigger once every 240 sec
\[Counter King] Counter becomes a sustained stance that consumes Stamina and can be canceled manually[/p][p]\[High Roller] Multiply Dark Tide Coins by a random 0.1x–50x multiplier (at most 100000)
\[Currency of Survival] When taking lethal damage, consumes 20,000 Dark Tide Coins to negate the damage and knock back nearby enemies. You will restore 1,000 Health.
2. Hero Technique
Ye Xiu Exclusive Technique
\[Unspecialized Blitz·Draco Might] Defeating enemies during Unspecialized Blitz restores uses of Soaring Dragon
\[Unspecialized Blitz·Surge] During Unspecialized Blitz, the Fake Combo builds much faster[/p][p]III. Technique Adjustments[/p][p]1. \[Jabbing·Through]'s hit Damage Multiplier reduced from 5.04 to 4.65; \[Tempest Kick·Chill]'s hit Damage Multiplier reduced from 0.89*7 to 0.79*7.[/p][p]2. \[Legacy·Longsword], \[Legacy·Greatsword], \[Legacy·Dagger], \[Legacy·Dual Blades], and \[Legacy·Katana] have been merged into \[Legacy Tome]: randomly obtain one weapon tome (Longsword/Greatsword/Dagger/Dual Blades/Katana) with +21% Tome Damage.[/p][p]3. Techniques \[Guerilla] and \[Dodge Master] have been removed.[/p][p]IV. Collection Adjustments[/p][p]Added map filtering to \[Technique Collection], allowing you to view Techniques for the corresponding map.[/p][p]V. Easy Battle Adjustments[/p][p]Adjusted the maximum Reward Draw limit for Showdown Omens:[/p][p] [/p][p]1. \[Doubled Gains]: Gain 150% additional settlement rewards and 20 additional free Anima Rings refreshes in Nirriti's Ruins mode. The maximum number of times per week has been reduced from 3 to 2.[/p][p]2. \[Rage Revenue]: Gain 150% additional settlement rewards and significantly increased Rage conversion in Enigma Domain mode. The reward limit has been adjusted from 3 times a week to 3 times a day.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]In-game Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Target's Health bar will no longer be displayed while using camera lock-on.[/p][p]II. In BOT Mode and Quick Match, adjusted the first 2 phases of the Shadow Corruption:
Phase 1: Damage adjusted from 2% per sec to 1% per sec.
Phase 2: Damage adjusted from 3% per sec to 2% per sec.[/p][p]III. Specialized Practice[/p][p]1. Newly added Water Combat. Complete it to get Hero Coin*50.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Out-game Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. A \[Recommended] tab has been added to the gameplay selection screen.[/p][p]A \[Recommended] tab has been added to The Herald's Trial gameplay selection screen. The tab dynamically recommends suitable gameplay options based on the player's identity and unlock status.[/p][p]II. Increased the weapon proficiency gained from Flamebringer, Swarm, and Bloodrippers at settlement.[/p][p]III. When a custom selection contains too many options, a search box will appear.[/p][p]IV. Added an adjustable \[Metallic] parameter in Customization - Face - Lip Makeup.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Container: The public display phase has been removed for crates that require dice rolls.[/p][p]II. In-Game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Optimized interaction with the Chime Bell. Multiple players can now interact with it simultaneously without interruption, and the first to complete the puzzle claims the reward.[/p][p]2. Adjusted a spawn point for a Qin Soldier·Archer in the northern part of Dang County Barrack on the Stormchant map that would occasionally sink into the ground.[/p][p]3. Improved map warnings for the Execution Ground in the River Runs Red map, and added a priority window for rescuing prisoners to the player who lands the first Counter on the executioner.[/p][p]4. Fixed an issue in Stormchant where triggering a Trap Crate would count toward guaranteed collectible progress.[/p][p]III. Crossover Guarantee Adjustment[/p][p]In a single Rift Traversal match, at most 1 crossover guarantee can be triggered; the remaining guarantee will be available in subsequent matches.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Showdown Adjustments[/b][/h1][p] [/p][p]I. Function Adjustments[/p][p]1. Changed unlock conditions for certain stages to Showdown Level requirements
The unlock conditions for \[Enigma Peak], \[Tempered Inferno], \[Tempered Inferno·Nightscream], \[Doom Speedrun], and \[The Boundless] have been changed from "clearing the prerequisite stage" to "reaching a specified Showdown Level." Level requirements vary by stage. The newly added \[Random Stage] is also unlocked via Showdown Level.

//Dev Note: With this change, players can unlock these stages by engaging in any PVE content, without being required to progress through the main story. The main story will now focus more on narrative guidance and early-game progression, retaining unlock functions for only certain stages.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Added "Random Stage" to Doom mode.[/p][p]In a Random Stage, a main-story stage whose entry level matches your current Showdown Level will be randomly selected from the stages you have unlocked. The selected stage's entry level will not exceed your current Showdown Level, and will be at most 40 Levels lower.[/p][p]During party challenges, the random selection is based on the member with the lowest Showdown Level in the team.[/p][p]The monsters, Omens, and rewards in the stage correspond to the randomly selected stage.[/p][p]If any other player in the team has not yet achieved a first clear of the selected stage, your Showdown Level suppression over monsters will not apply.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. When using a Souljade Choice Gift with many selectable Souljades, a search box will be displayed.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]1. The area triggered by stacking \[Toxified] can now benefit from \[Poison Blast DMG] bonuses; the original base multiplier has been reduced to 5.[/p][p]2. Souljade \[Thunder Counter] added effect: "Divine Thunder no longer causes stagger, but maximum Thundershock accumulation is reduced." Souljade \[Thunderproof] becomes a Faded Souljade.[/p][p]3. Adjustments to Kurumi's Ultimate \[Purified Circle: Showdown]:[/p][p]Ultimate cost adjusted to 50% Rage;[/p][p]Landing ice or thunder elemental strikes, or applying Toxified or Burn, causes the Healing Circle to gain elemental effects.[/p][p]When the Healing Circle gains an elemental effect, its recast count is refreshed.[/p][p]Added Thunder Healing Circle: deals electric strike damage per second and benefits from Divine Thunder DMG bonuses.[/p][p]Ice Healing Circle effect enhanced: deals ice strike damage per second and benefits from Ice Blast DMG bonuses.[/p][p]Poison Healing Circle effect enhanced: applies 1 stack of Toxified every 1.5 seconds.[/p][p]Fire Healing Circle effect enhanced: applies 1 stack of Burn per second, lasting 4 seconds, stacking up to 5 stacks.[/p][p]4. Horizontal \[Soul Slash] Damage Multiplier increased from 12.1 to 22.99; Vertical \[Soul Slash] Damage Multiplier increased from 9.5 to 18.1.[/p][p]5. Added \[Aegis-break Clash]: Certain moves can clash with large enemies' melee attacks. On success, the enemy's attack is interrupted and their Astral Aegis is weakened; follow-up attacks can unlock a powerful counter. Can be triggered by Temulch's Aegis-break Martial Skill, Temulch's Defuse Skill, and Inor Wan's Aegis-break Martial Skill.[/p][p]6. Agnivat's \[Solar Frostfall] cannot be triggered by Aegis-break Clash.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Function Optimizations[/b][/h1][p] [/p][p]I. Optimized how certain monsters push away player characters while moving.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Store Updates[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Lucky Wheel[/p][p] [/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 3rd, 2026 Update - Oct 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p]Event Rules: 1. During the event, select your preferred rewards from each tier to build your own exclusive prize pool of 10 custom rewards.[/p][p]New Rewards: Anassa Nangong Extreme Outfit \[Abyssal Fiend], Temulch Legendary Outfit \[Tome of Journey·Curtain-Lifting General], Dual Blades Legendary Skin \[Soulflutter], and more.[/p][p]2. New Pack[/p][p] [/p][p]1. newsitems.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 13th, 2026

newsitems.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 12th, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to August 13th, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][h2][b]I. The King's Avatar Crossover casual mode: Dual-Phase Brawl[/b][/h2][p]Peak of glory, fight to the top! Heroes rise — write the next legend of The King's Avatar in the arena and team battles![/p][p]1. Claim the training skills rewards for The King's Avatar Account Card via Event Center - A Single Fire Spark - Character Training;[/p][p]2. Select the The King's Avatar account card you wish to bring into the match.[/p][p]3. Choose Arena Match or Team Battle.[/p][p]Arena Match:[/p][p]· Players fight in turn; the winner stays to continue.[/p][p]· Each win grants a Buff to teammates in Team Battle.[/p][p]· 1v2 and 1v3 victories award bonus points.[/p][p]· After Arena Match ends, join the Team Battle for the final clash.[/p][p]Team Battle:[/p][p]· Players revive infinitely; eliminating enemies earns points.[/p][p]· Consecutive eliminations / eliminating Bounty target grant bonus points.[/p][p]· The Spirit Well appears at intervals; capturing it grants generous rewards.[/p][p]4. Both battles contribute to the same score. The faction with the higher total score wins.[/p][p]5. Based on match results and game performance, earn event Score Rewards from Event Center - A Single Fire Spark - Dual-Phase Brawl.[/p][h2][b]II. Showdown's New Event Mode: Skyfall Cataclysm[/b][/h2][p]Chaos descends on Lin'an. The Nexus Gate opens. Heroes raise their blades to cut down the Enchanted, dispel the darkness, and restore peace to the mortal world.[/p][p]1. Basic Rules[/p][p]Chaos seeks to corrupt Lin'an City. Heroes must wipe out monsters under the pressure of the chaotic Shadow Corruption, grow stronger, and finally pass through the Nexus Gate to defeat the Enchanted boss within and dispel the chaotic corruption.[/p][p]Some Showdown heroes are available in this mode. None of the Showdown out-of-game progression carries into this mode.[/p][p]· Each match randomly assigns a weakness to the final Enchanted Boss (weak to Melee/Element/Ranged). Plan your route based on your spawn location, the Boss's weakness, and the resource stronghold drop tendencies for that match.[/p][p]· Clear an entire resource stronghold or defeat an Elite/Boss monster to obtain Souljades from stronghold chests. These Souljades apply to your in-match gear.[/p][p]· Defeat monsters to gain EXP and raise your team Level. Each resource stronghold has a recommended Level, attacking one above your team Level will be extremely difficult.[/p][p]· The Realm of Eclipse appears after a set time each match. Challenge the boss inside for generous rewards! If you fail, well... there's always the next run![/p][p]· In the late game, a Nexus Gate leading to the final Enchanted Boss appears within the safe zone. Watch the timer and head there. As Shadow Corruption spreads, the area will be affected as well.[/p][p]· There are also some surprise items in the scene waiting to be discovered![/p][p]2. Out-of-Game Progression[/p][p]Skyfall Cataclysm progression only takes effect in this mode.[/p][p]· Complete matches or quests to earn "Calamity Crystals", used in the Skyfall Fateboard system to unlock fateboards and boost strength.
· Defeating monsters may also yield "Lingering Artifacts". One artifact can be activated per match for powerful extra effects.[/p][p]3. Fatigue and Drops[/p][p]Skyfall Cataclysm boosts only take effect in matches, but Fatigue can still be spent to obtain various Showdown progression materials and secure the current version's top-tier set immediately.[/p][p]Skyfall Cataclysm offers two difficulties with different Fatigue costs, but Souljade drop rates are the same across all stages.[/p][p]Obtained after the first clear:[/p][p]\[Threefold Gathering], \[Four Spirits Converge], \[Thunderpull], \[Thunderproof][/p][p]Stage drops:[/p][p]\[Element Surge], \[Thunder Charge], \[Forsaken Force], \[Tempered Force], \[Dual Spirit Marks], \[General·Sap][/p][p]Plus three new \[Move] Souljades, which in the current version can only be obtained from Skyfall Cataclysm (effects vary by Souljade element):[/p][p]\[Spear·Azure Dragon Break]: The Vertical Strike after Spear Horizontal Finishers, a missed Dragonslayer, or a missed Heartstopper Kick changes, and deals extra Frostbite Accumulation. A Dodge after a Perfect Dodge or Defuse (Counterattack) hit can also chain into Azure Dragon Break with increased damage.[/p][p]\[Katana·Thunderstorm]: Alters Katana's charged Horizontal Strikes and deals extra Frostbite Accumulation. A Dodge after a Perfect Dodge or Defuse (Counterattack) hit can also chain into Thunderstorm with increased damage.[/p][p] [/p][p]\[Dual Blades·Octa-Slash Blade]: Alters the Dual Blades' Vertical Strike after a charged attack and deals extra Frostbite Accumulation. During Octa-Slash Blade move, Dodge and launch a Vertical Strike to continue the Octa-Slash Blade move. A Perfect Dodge instantly unleashes the finishing blow.[/p][h2][b]III. Limited-time Events[/b][/h2][p]1. All Tribulations Fade[/p][p] [/p][p]With a steadfast heart, face all eighty-one trials[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 13th, 2026 Update - Sep. 2nd, 2026 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) Complete daily quests to obtain Passage Scrolls. Submit them to retrace the Journey to the West and unlock rewards.[/p][p](2) Each submission yields a Violet-gold Bowl with rewards like Myriad Treasure*5, Serene Treasure Choice Gift*5, Imprint Roller, and Kite![/p][p] [/p][p]2. Formless Heavenfall[/p][p] [/p][p]As calamity looms and shadows fall, heroes draw their blades and rise.[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 13th, 2026 Update - Aug. 26th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]1. Complete quests during the event to claim rewards.[/p][p]2. There are 5 quest sets, unlocking one after another daily upon the event start.[/p][p]3. Quests must be completed in order, and completing all 5 sets will grant the full event rewards.[/p][h2][b]IV. Official Team Shopping[/b][/h2][p]Event Duration: Aug. 27th, 2026, 04:00 (UTC) - Sep 9th, 2026, 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, joining the presale builds Server Cheer Point. The higher the cheer point, the lower the final price, up to the max discount.[/p][p]2. During the presale, pay a 240 Gold deposit for \[The Harvest Matron Pack] and claim the presale bonus: Serene Treasure Choice Gift*1.[/p][p]3. When the item goes on sale, presale ends. Presale players must pay the remaining balance at the final discount price to get the item. Note: If the balance is not paid before the event ends, the deposit will not be refunded.[/p][p]4. Players who miss the presale can buy the item at the final discount price when it releases, but will not receive the Presale Bonus.[/p][p]5. During the official Team Shopping period, the event page closes after purchase.[/p][p] [/p][p]Hero Adjustments[/p][p]I. Ye Xiu[/p][p]1. Adjusted the duration of the \[Unspecialized Blitz: Soaring Dragon] Ultimate in Trios mode from 22 sec to 25 sec. No changes in Solo and Duos modes.[/p][p]2. For the \[Unspecialized Blitz] Ultimate: while in Ultimate state, Cannon form non-enhanced Charged Attack damage adjusted from 1.3/1.5 to 1.2/1.3, and Cannon form enhanced Charged Attack damage adjusted from 1.3/1.8 to 1.2/1.3
Cannon-form Charged Attacks can no longer stagger Blue Focus Strikes.
Scythe-form Charged Attack damage adjusted from 1.5/1.0 to 1.5/1.5[/p][p]3. Counterstrike Combo performed while in the Ultimate state now grants a 65% recovery effect based on the damage dealt.[/p][p]4. The knockback strike when Ye Xiu casts \[Soaring Dragon] will no longer trigger Shayol Wei's \[Black Tortoise Block].[/p][p]5. Slightly increased the starting speed and horizontal jump speed while charging and moving in Ultimate state.[/p][p] [/p][p]//Dev Note: Currently, Ye Xiu's \[Unspecialized Blitz] tends to overperform by staying in Cannon form, dealing excessive damage. We have made balance adjustments to the Cannon and Scythe forms, hoping to encourage Ye Xiu players to make better use of different weapon forms when using his Ultimate \[Unspecialized Blitz].[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Yoto Hime[/p][p]1. Optimized the input window for \[Flying Edge] following an Uppercut Slash.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Yueshan[/p][p]1. Optimized the Almighty General's performance in water.[/p][h1][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Kaleidoscope Parasol[/p][p]1. \[Kaleidoscope·Parasol]
Increased the damage area of its Charged Horizontal Strike; hitting a downed enemy now launches them airborne.
2. \[Kaleidoscope·Shield]
Increased the damage area of the 2nd-stage Horizontal Strike.[/p][p]3. \[Kaleidoscope·Axe][/p][p]Increased the damage area of its Charged Horizontal Strikes[/p][p]4. Optimized the animation of the Quick Counter.[/p][p]5. Optimized the moving distance of the charged Vertical Strike while sprinting.[/p][h1][b]Water Combat Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]1. Ascending no longer launches you out of water upon reaching the surface; instead, you will stay in the water surface.[/p][p]2. Using Dodge during Ascending or Descending will no longer trigger a special dodge.[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue where repeatedly tapping Space while Ascending to the water surface could accidentally trigger a Double Jump.[/p][p]4. Optimized the animation when taking damage while on the water surface.[/p][p]5. Attack moves on the water surface now are the same as those performed when diving.[/p][p]6. Added a 2nd Horizontal Strike for the Water Skimming state.[/p][p]7. Optimized the visual effects of Ascend and Descend.[/p][p] [/p][p]In-game Adjustments[/p][p]I. newsitems.author: Misty
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/9d95d4b1c8d8667a9d31b6f18e57b0638dfcd26c.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]A Fast, Unpredictable New Fighter[/b][/h2][p]Ye Xiu’s skill set has been carefully designed to reflect the tactical approach of his original character, making him far more than a simple cosmetic reskin. His combat mechanics are built around rapid movement, counterattacks, and flexible combo chains, while offering both powerful area-of-effect damage and impressive single-target burst. [/p][p]This makes him one of the few truly well-rounded heroes in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, delivering exceptional versatility with virtually no weaknesses. [/p][p][b]Ye Xiu CG:[/b][/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wbx9B4yoEI4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]
[b]Ye Xiu Gameplay:[/b][/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vmRYOoyVhFk"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h2][b]NARAKA’s First Transforming Weapon[/b][/h2][p]The Kaleidoscope Parasol is the first weapon in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT that can freely cycle between multiple forms during combat.[/p][p]Players can switch between Parasol, Shield, and Axe forms to adapt to different battlefield situations, moving between flexible attacks, defensive options, and powerful close-range strikes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/5ed625dcec2cb8dd8d8c55ccc83cb47c1e1a297b.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]A Five-Year Legacy of "Unfettered" Spirit[/b][/h2][p]The inclusion of Ye Xiu marks a thematic milestone for Naraka: Bladepoint. Much like Ye Xiu’s journey in the iconic anime series, The King’s Avatar, starting from zero to reclaim glory, for half a decade, 24 Entertainment has worked to demonstrate that Chinese martial arts hold a legitimate place within the competitive gaming landscape. This update serves as a tribute to that shared spirit of persistence and the pursuit of glory.[/p][p]Log in to NARAKA: BLADEPOINT on July 30 to claim Ye Xiu for free and unleash his fast, fluid combat with the transforming Kaleidoscope Parasol.[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.author: Yeeeeee
